# Third-party code

Code copied from other projects. Files here keep their upstream content,
formatting and license, so the repository's format and license scripts skip
this folder.

## rfw

[Remote Flutter Widgets](https://pub.dev/packages/rfw) 2.0.0, from
[flutter/packages](https://github.com/flutter/packages/tree/main/packages/rfw).
BSD 3-Clause license; see `rfw/LICENSE`.

Contents: `AUTHORS`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `LICENSE`, `README.md`, `pubspec.yaml`,
`lib/` and `test/` from the published package archive
(`https://pub.dev/api/archives/rfw-2.0.0.tar.gz`, SHA-256
`5e82ce64039a70de2c2db1381a055da8c1fdf45cc0069823797720f7847a281e`), unmodified.
The package's `example/`, `images/`, `test_coverage/` and CI scripts are left
out.

Craft's engine started as a fork of this code. Later changes are made
outside this folder, so this copy stays identical to the upstream release.
